battle-future-stage-study-prompt:
Original side-on combat stage study for a FUTURE SCIENCE-FICTION CITY. This is NOT an ancient/fantasy/medieval city and NOT a neon cyberpunk street. References1–2 are actual Herta Space Station screenshots: learn only the clean modular structures, composite-material frames, panel joints and shallow platform/railing geometry. Do not copy people, screens, logos, UI, plants, holograms, room layout or space-station theme. References3–5 are our actual card paintings: economical opaque anime brushwork, broad intentional directional paint planes, limited light/shadow, human irregular painterly edges and restrained color grouping only.
Build an original outdoor urban transit plaza/platform in a calm near-future metropolis. Far background: quiet clean tower slabs and a simple elevated transit link, few distant city masses, desaturated blue-gray atmosphere. Mid scene: modern white/gray composite-frame supports at far left/right, simple low modular rear barrier, restrained utility housings. Material language is matte metal, composite panels and modern concrete, no stacked masonry blocks, castle arches/domes, classical columns, ancient ruins, wooden gates, flags/banners or medieval ornaments.
A wide uninterrupted HORIZONTAL combat platform spans left to right, in shallow side-facing perspective. Rear edge about y55%; broad foot-contact band y70–78%; front lip y94%. Floor uses three or four coherent warm-gray/cool-gray opaque paint masses and a few clean panel seams, not dense paving bricks or grunge triangles. No giant central vanishing-point road, hole under actors, or empty upper half of sky.
Clearly separable far, mid, ground and low foreground parts in one16:9 common canvas. Leave character silhouette regions x8–28% and x56–92%, y28–78% low detail and low contrast. Mid framing near x0–8%/94–100% only. Foreground = a few dark modular curb/service-cover shapes at extreme lower corners, no rail across faces/feet/HUD. No people or monsters, character-shaped shadows, cards/UI/text/labels, decorative tech diagrams, holographic advertisements, magenta/cyan neon wash, particle effects, snow or ice.
Paint matching our card artwork, NOT a smooth3D/PBR render: big readable shape groups, hand-painted broad opaque strokes following material direction, limited hard-edge light/shadow, sparse purposeful highlights. No uniform polygon mosaic, microtexture, photographic surface or glossy wet reflections. Technology comes from designed structures/materials, not glowing strips everywhere. This is a functional side-on2D battle stage, not a scenic wallpaper.
